Brief error burst 0 to 0.34 at 42s lasting to ~100s while log volume collapsed 369 to 9, first victim showing errors during auth stall as caller of travel services.
Workload collapsed 8.8 to 0 from 100s onward with spans 2642 to 299, called by travel/travel2, downstream traffic loss victim after auth/admin-travel onset at 42-45s.
Workload collapsed 6.7 to 0 from 100s onward with spans 2022 to 182, same pattern as route and called by same travel callers, victim of upstream stall.
Socket and spans collapsed 2170 to 285 with logs 3925 to 605 and first exceed at 141s, caller of route/train linking admin-travel to route/train collapse, victim not origin.
